figures.label: Qualification Time Window
figures.source: CA needs the longest family-funded runway (4-7 years, low-income articleship). CMA needs a shorter, cheaper runway (2.5-4 years, lower total fees). CFA needs steady income from a job while you study for exams part-time, plus 36 months of qualifying work experience before the charter itself is official.
